Connect Tari wallet

Connect through the Tari wallet available in this browser.
1
Select Connect wallet below to create a private pairing link.
2
Copy the pairing link. Do not scan it with MetaMask or another Ethereum wallet.
3
Open Tari Asset Vault, select Connect with WalletConnect, paste the link, and approve XTM Market.
Copy this link into Tari Asset Vault

This is a Tari Ootle connection. Opening or scanning the link may send it to the wrong wallet.

◈No wallet API key is requested or stored. XTM Market receives only the wallet details and transaction approvals you grant.

Your wallet must be connected to the Esmeralda testnet. View the Tari dApp integration guide.
